name: The Crone of the Kraul
summary: At Thalanaar, on the border of Feralas and the Thousand Needles, Falfindel Waywarder sends adventurers after Charlga Razorflank. Henrig Lonebrow's recovered journal reveals the growing danger inside Razorfen Kraul.

sections.title: A Plea at the Border
sections.body: At secluded Thalanaar, the night elf outpost, Falfindel Waywarder grieves for the druid Heralath and the dwarf Henrig Lonebrow. Lonebrow traveled with the Explorers' League before the quilboar captured him. He escaped Razorfen Kraul, but died on the road, leaving a tattered journal that describes the growing menace inside. There is no time to send a runner to Darnassus for military reinforcements. Falfindel sends passing adventurers into the thorned dens to face the danger at its heart.

sections.title: Striking the Chieftain
sections.body: Charlga Razorflank is an ancient geomancer and ruthless matriarch who has united the fractious Razorfen quilboar under her iron rule. From deep within the Kraul, she marshals a bristling army that threatens neighboring lands. Thick thorn mazes, battlement walls, and swarms of fanatical quilboar warriors guard the way to Charlga. Her medallion, taken from her lifeless body, will prove her downfall.

sections.title: A Deeper Corruption
sections.body: Charlga's death blunts the immediate quilboar threat, but leaves the night elves with deeper concerns. The living briars of the Kraul sprouted where the boar Ancient, Agamaggan, fell during the War of the Ancients. When Falfindel receives the medallion, he notes that neutralizing Charlga allows night elf scholars to study the area's corruption more closely. He senses insidious treachery may lie at the root of the sudden blight sweeping Agamaggan's sacred remains.

faq.q: Who gives the quest The Crone of the Kraul?
aliases: quest giver crone of the kraul
where do i get crone of the kraul
faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder, a night elf stationed at Thalanaar, gives it. Thalanaar is an Alliance outpost on the high mountain pass between Feralas and the Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before starting this quest?
aliases: prereq for crone of the kraul
how to unlock crone of the kraul
faq.answer: First, you must complete Lonebrow's Journal. Retrieve Henrig Lonebrow's journal from his fallen remains near the Great Lift in Thousand Needles, then deliver it to Falfindel in Thalanaar.

Charlga Razorflank is the supreme crone and matriarch of the Razorfen quilboar. A powerful geomancer, she has united the warring tribes within Razorfen Kraul and directs their aggression against neighboring territories.

faq.q: Where can Charlga Razorflank be found?
aliases: where is the crone in rfk
faq.answer: Charlga Razorflank waits at the very end of Razorfen Kraul, in the far southern corner of the Barrens near the Great Lift. She waits atop an altar deep inside the dungeon.

faq.q: Why does Falfindel need adventurers instead of calling the Darnassus army?
faq.answer: Thalanaar is a remote frontier outpost far from northern Kalimdor. Charlga is actively amassing her forces, and word sent to Darnassus would take too long to bring a dispatched army and avert the rising danger.

faq.q: What proof does Falfindel demand of the crone's death?
faq.answer: Falfindel requires Razorflank's Medallion, the amulet Charlga wears, as proof that she has been slain.

angles.text: This is the Alliance's main effort against the quilboar menace in the southern Barrens, launched from Thalanaar.
Night elves grieve over the desecration of Agamaggan's resting place. The boar Ancient fell as an ally of the night elves during the War of the Ancients.
Avenging the explorer Henrig Lonebrow gives dwarves a personal stake in storming the quilboar stronghold.
As a druid, you hold Agamaggan in high esteem as a revered Ancient of nature and seek to cleanse the dark taint distorting his thorn-covered legacy.
